source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hey, nice work on the board! I reviewed the schematic and PCB files thoroughly, and they look solid overall. I only noticed a few points. Could you check them and let me know your thoughts?

1. USB-C connector (USB1) — The DRC reports hole clearance violations and negative annular width for the 2 mounting pin holes. It appears that the footprint’s drill is larger than its copper pad. Will JLCPCB accept that, or does it have to be corrected?
2. VMID (pin 36) on AXP2101 — On the PCB, it is tied to the same net as VSYS. VMID should be the internal ADC reference, so I would expect it to be isolated from VSYS with only a cap to GND. Could you verify this using the datasheet or a reference design?
3. R6 (4.7k) — It makes sense that the D1 LED is marked DNP, but R6, its current-limiting resistor, remains in the BOM and would be assembled. Because D1 will not be placed, one pin of R6 would float. Should R6 be marked DNP too, or is there a reason to retain it?
4. VSIS net name — This seems to be a typo for VSYS. It is only cosmetic, but correcting it would prevent confusion.
5. L1 inductor footprint — The DRC says that L\_Changjiang\_FTC404020S cannot be found in the standard KiCad library and that a local override is being used. I just want to verify that its physical dimensions match the 4.7uH inductor you intend to use.

ambiguity.description: Whether R6 should also be marked DNP while the on-board D1 charge LED is unpopulated is unresolved.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
For the power board, these are the only changes I need:
1\. Add J\_LED\_CHG (2-pin JST-[FREELANCER_NAME_002]) — use the CHGLED circuit with a 270Ω resistor, while D1 remains DNP
2\. Update R6 from 4.7kΩ to 270Ω and remove DNP
I realized that I will need that led in the future anyway.
